segments.ja457:1.3: Maggāraho devamanussapūjito, dhammo ahaṃ dehi adhamma maggaṃ.
segments.ja457:2.3: Sa kissa hetumhi tavajja dajjaṃ, maggaṃ ahaṃ dhamma adinnapubbaṃ.
segments.ja457:3.1: Dhammo have pāturahosi pubbe, pacchā adhammo udapādi loke;
segments.ja457:3.3: Jeṭṭho ca seṭṭho ca sanantano ca, uyyāhi jeṭṭhassa kaniṭṭha maggā.
segments.ja457:4.1: Na yācanāya napi pātirūpā, na arahatā [na arahati (sī. pī.), arahati (ka.)] tehaṃ dadeyyaṃ maggaṃ;
segments.ja457:4.3: Yuddhañca no hotu ubhinnamajja, yuddhamhi yo jessati tassa maggo.
segments.ja457:5.1: Sabbā disā anuvisaṭohamasmi, mahabbalo amitayaso atulyo;
segments.ja457:5.3: Guṇehi sabbehi upetarūpo, dhammo adhamma tvaṃ kathaṃ vijessasi.
segments.ja457:6.1: Lohena ve haññati jātarūpaṃ, na jātarūpena hananti lohaṃ;
segments.ja457:6.3: Sace adhammo hañchati [haññati (sī. syā.), haññiti (katthaci)] dhammamajja, ayo suvaṇṇaṃ viya dassaneyyaṃ.
segments.ja457:7.1: Sace tuvaṃ yuddhabalo adhamma [yuddhabalo’ si’ dhamma (ka. sī.), yuddhabalo’ sa’ dhamma (pī.)], na tuyha vuḍḍhā [vaddhā (sī. pī.)] ca garū ca atthi;
segments.ja457:7.3: Maggañca te dammi piyāppiyena, vācāduruttānipi te khamāmi.
segments.ja457:8.1: Idañca sutvā vacanaṃ adhammo, avaṃsiro patito uddhapādo;
segments.ja457:8.3: “Yuddhatthiko ce na labhāmi yuddhaṃ”, ettāvatā hoti hato adhammo.
segments.ja457:9.1: Khantībalo yuddhabalaṃ vijetvā, hantvā adhammaṃ nihanitva [vihanitvā (ka.)] bhūmyā;
segments.ja457:9.3: Pāyāsi vitto [citto (syā.)] abhiruyha sandanaṃ, maggeneva atibalo saccanikkamo.
segments.ja457:10.1: Mātā pitā samaṇabrāhmaṇā ca, asammānitā yassa sake agāre;
segments.ja457:10.3: Idheva nikkhippa sarīradehaṃ, kāyassa bhedā nirayaṃ vajanti te [vajanti (sī. pī.)];
segments.ja457:11.1: Mātā pitā samaṇabrāhmaṇā ca, susammānitā yassa sake agāre;
segments.ja457:11.3: Idheva nikkhippa sarīradehaṃ, kāyassa bhedā sugatiṃ vajanti te;
